author: Gary Franchi
title: DEEP STATE POLLING: Fox Survey Shows Americans Want Peace While Media Attacks Trump's Popularity | Next News Network
text:
A new Fox News poll shows the American people are firmly behind President Trump's America First foreign policy, with 58% opposing U.S. military action in Iran – a clear vindication of Trump's promise to keep us out of endless foreign wars.
The survey results expose the stark difference between what everyday Americans want and what the Washington establishment has been pushing for decades. While the military-industrial complex and neoconservative warmongers have spent years beating the drums for conflict with Iran, the American people are saying 'enough is enough' to foreign entanglements that drain our resources and put our troops at risk.
But here's where it gets interesting, Patriots. The same poll that shows Americans backing Trump's peace-through-strength approach also claims his disapproval rating has hit 59% – the highest of his second term. Curious timing, isn't it? Just as Trump is delivering on his campaign promises to secure the border, cut government waste through Elon Musk's DOGE initiative, and keep us out of foreign wars, suddenly the polls are pushing negative narratives.
This reeks of the same polling manipulation we've seen for years from the mainstream media and their deep state allies. They prop up anti-Trump numbers while simultaneously reporting data that proves Americans support his policies. It's almost like they're trying to have it both ways – acknowledge public support for Trump's agenda while undermining his presidency through manufactured disapproval ratings.
Americans Want Peace, Not Endless Wars
The Iran polling numbers tell the real story. After decades of disastrous military interventions in Iraq, Afghanistan, Libya, and Syria, the American people have learned their lesson. They want a president who puts America First, not one who sends our young men and women to die for globalist adventures overseas.
President Trump campaigned on ending the era of endless wars, and this poll proves the American people are with him. While the establishment media continues to push for conflict, real Americans want their tax dollars spent on fixing our roads, securing our border, and making America great again – not funding regime change operations halfway around the world.
The question isn't whether Americans support Trump's foreign policy – clearly they do. The question is: will the deep state and their media allies stop trying to manipulate public opinion with rigged polling designed to undermine our democratically elected president?
